ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Aarti Drugs Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 19% and EBITDA up 30% year-on-year, driven by improved API realizations, volume growth, and operational efficiencies that expanded margins by 120 basis points. Despite a reported PAT decline due to a prior year's tax refund, underlying profit growth was a robust 29%. The company is strategically expanding capacity, including for Metformin's future US market entry (12+ months out), to capitalize on evolving market opportunities amidst a volatile global API landscape.
